description: Utopia fluid type, space and control sizes. Design at utopia.fyi and paste the settings here. The range is the width of the container a view sits in, not the viewport. The space multipliers are chosen so the widest values are Spacefast's 4px spacing scale exactly (2, 4, 6 … 48); common.tokens.json names them spacing.0_5 to spacing.12.

sizeScale.description: Control heights as multiples of the base font size. Every step must stay at or above the 24px WCAG 2.5.8 pointer target at the narrowest container; the generator refuses one that does not.
